name: @patronage/wordpress-fields
description: ACF field groups, post types and demo seed shared by the Launch WordPress installs.

scripts.test: for f in patronage-fields.php post-types.php field-values.php rich-text-blocks.php fields/*.php seed/*.php tests/*.php; do php -l "$f" >/dev/null || exit 1; done && php tests/field-values.test.php && php tests/rich-text-blocks.test.php
